Known vulnerable MCP servers, plus startup and folder-open hooks.

New in this release:

- Every MCP server agent-preflight finds is compared against a small, dated list of servers with published vulnerabilities (built in, dated 2026-10-29). It covers the nine MCP server CVEs VulnCheck published on October 27, 2026 (CVE-2026-117558 to CVE-2026-117573) and the AWS API MCP Server token audience bug CVE-2026-115413. A match is reported as a `known-vulnerable` finding even after `--approve`, because approving a server does not patch it. Matching is by package or repository name, so a hit means "check which version you run", not proof you are affected.
- `--vuln-list` (or `$AGENT_PREFLIGHT_VULN_LIST`) uses your own copy of the list instead of the built-in one.
- Startup and folder-open hooks: Gemini CLI hooks, Cursor `mcp.json` (MCP servers and command hooks), Cursor rules, VS Code `runOn: folderOpen` tasks, devcontainer lifecycle commands and large or obfuscated `.github/init.js` files are now listed and flagged.

Binaries below are static builds for Linux and macOS (amd64 and arm64). Check them against checksums.txt. You can also install from source:

    go install github.com/sudodrift/agent-preflight/cmd/agent-preflight@v0.2.0
